name: GodHands
long_description: GodHands learns how your teams actually work, capturing the steps, decisions, and exceptions that never get written down. It turns that knowledge into living playbooks and answers with sources, so people and AI agents can put it to work. Teams use GodHands to run operations, onboard employees, hand over roles, integrate acquisitions, and automate work.
one_liner: Your company’s operating model, learned from the work.

founders.title: Founder/CEO
founders.founder_bio: Co-founder & CEO of GodHands. We learn how companies actually operate and turn that knowledge into playbooks and answers for people and AI agents. Previously a quantitative researcher at a high-frequency trading firm. IIT Kharagpur CS.

founders.title: Founder/CTO
founders.founder_bio: Co-founder & CTO of GodHands. We capture how work gets done, including the decisions and exceptions, so people and AI agents can carry it forward. Previously built low-latency systems at a high-frequency trading firm. Published research at NeurIPS. IIT Delhi CS.
